user.title: Connect Health-e Pro Menu
user.description:
Paste the public Health-e Pro menu URL from your school's lunch page.

Example: {example_url}

data_description.custom_name: Override the auto-detected school/menu name shown in Home Assistant. Leave blank to use the name from Health-e Pro.

error.invalid_url: That doesn't look like a Health-e Pro menu URL. Make sure the URL contains /organizations/…/sites/…/menus/…
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Health-e Pro. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.not_found: The menu, site, or organization was not found. Double-check the URL.
error.no_published_months: No published months found for this menu. The menu may not be active yet.

abort.already_configured: This menu is already set up.
